limitations: Browser drag verification covers release within the embedded preview.

Chrome can omit pointer-up events after crossing the iframe boundary. Focus-loss and mouse-reentry release guards are included, but the production host should forward pointer termination across that boundary. Keep audition drags inside the preview.
No ESP32 rendering performance, physical touch device or firmware integration validation.
Gesture recipes are preserved; browser execution exercised the three happy recipes, not every 132 performance as an individual movie.
